title: Requests to the Partner team
body: Ask to change your factory's details; the Partner team answers here

form.messageTooShort: Please give at least 3 characters of detail
form.sent: Request sent — the Partner team will answer
form.ownerOnly: The factory owner sends requests to the Partner team

placeholders.capability: e.g. We bought a 4-colour offset press and can now make folding cartons
placeholders.capacity: e.g. Add a second shift for corrugated boxes from 1 Nov
placeholders.delivery_zones: e.g. Add Chonburi and Rayong to our delivery area
placeholders.tolerance: e.g. Change tolerance to 3% under, 5% over
placeholders.participation_tier: e.g. We want more jobs — what do we need to do?
placeholders.pricing_arrangement: e.g. Per-piece pricing for runs over 10,000
placeholders.site_visit: e.g. New machine installed, please visit the factory
placeholders.other: What would you like to tell getpack?
